# Test fixtures

Recorded responses from the public sources the live layer reads, trimmed to the fields the collectors use. Each file name
carries the date it was recorded. Files whose name starts with `synthetic-` are hand made in the shape of a real response,
for cases the public record did not offer on the day of recording (a freeze warning in a mild week, an error page); they
are used only to exercise code paths and never reach the app.
